Thanks for the context, Kimberly. A few proposed mitigations to limit revenue/risk exposure:

1) Limit the Net-90 pilot to the first two quarters only (180 days) and explicitly revert to monthly billing thereafter unless an extension is approved by Finance.
2) Include a clause for automatic early-invoice reconciliation on renewal (so unpaid amounts must be cleared prior to renewal invoicing).
3) Require Stratagem to set up ACH and provide PO / billing contact; place invoices on electronic approval to minimize delays.
4) Add a $50k credit limit cap during the pilot or require a $50k pre-bill reserve to be held until the third payment clears.
5) Add standard late fee (1.5%/month) and 30-day payment reminder cadence before moving to collections.

If Finance is comfortable with the $50k exposure and the pilot guardrails we can mark this approved for signature and ask Legal to prepare the limited-term amendment to the MAPP.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly Invoicing + Net-90 Pilot for Enterprise Contract (Approval Conditions)

Kimberly / Laura — after reviewing the SOW and MAPP and running a quick credit check on Stratagem, Finance is willing to approve a limited Net-90 pilot with these conditions: 

1) Pilot limited to first two invoices (Q1 & Q2) only (180 days) and automatically terminates at the end of the pilot unless Finance signs an extension.
2) Maximum exposure during pilot capped at $75,000. If invoice totals exceed that cap, remaining charges must be remitted within 30 days.
3) Stratagem must provide ACH setup within 10 business days of signature; failure to do so voids the Net-90 concession and invoicing reverts to standard monthly terms.
4) Redwood will apply a 1.5% monthly late fee and suspend service on invoices 45 days overdue (after final reminder).
5) Approval requires a signed amendment to the MAPP explicitly documenting the pilot and a DocuSign link must be completed prior to first invoice.

I’ve cc'd Priyom for Deal Desk visibility — Priyom, please add a deal note and run the approval thru our internal exec queue if you think this needs further hands-on sign-off.

Kimberly — please update the SOW/MAPP with the amendment language and send the DocuSign link back to Stratagem billing.

Marcus Lin
VP Finance (Interim), Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
